item.title: Publications
item.description: The CLEF 2026 CEUR proceedings are not published yet: the links to the working notes and the per-task overview papers below will be added as soon as they are available. The general overview paper is in production with Springer (LNCS vol. 17087); its page numbers and DOI will be added once the volume appears. Overview paper Please, cite: Gasco, L., Fabregat, H., García-Sardiña, L., Estrella, P., Veys, W., Carrino, C.

item.title: Task A Results
item.description: Info. The official TalentCLEF 2026 Task A results are not published yet. The visualizations below will be filled in once the evaluation is closed. Below you will find the official results for Task A of TalentCLEF. This section provides both a graphical overview and a detailed table of the full results. The interactive visualizations are designed to help you explore and analyze the performance of participating systems based on different criteria.
